full_page.content:
1937, February
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
James Merng - 17 - Tricipilis - pneum.
Page 168 Feb. 10 Ernest Schultz - 9 - quite nervous - Mother wants him baptized Catholic - Mother Cath. - Father L. insists on having boy to be non-Cath. - boy anxious .
Frank Hasse of Pontiac - 38 - like sleeping-sickness-
Mrs. Gert DeJarden - 49 - prayed for about 6 weeks ago - died last Sunday of cancer - peaceful & happy death .....
16 Thomas J. Muldary - 66 of Adrian - bad ulcers of stomach.
16 Beatrice Loeckner - 31 - fearful Ecz. . Enrolled 50c promising perpetual and more frequent Com'n
17 Eugene Collins - 8 - a twin - paralysed - year and a half ... wants to be a priest. When a year old his brother started to creep .... Father invalid in Eloise mental.
17 Cooding boy of Pontiac - about 5 - cancer on forehead
Page 169
Feb. 17 Clara Mcclellan - about 40-double cataracts
Joseph Ksiazik - 24 - Epileptic ... every night .... sometimes fre- quently during day .....
Mr. Martin - 45 - goitre operat. To-morrow.
18 Lucile Ryckman - 20 - operated for gall-s'ns last Oct. Was to have another operation in Febr. was very sick for 9 days straight ... Dr. every day ... Was enrolled and made a promise to poorSS .... Has had no more trouble since. Dr. says its a miracle. (Dr. Dunn.)
Mrs. Butler - cancer of throat - fears operation
20 John Hart - 40 - in Kiefer's - T.B. about 10 yrs. from Conf. Serious - friends anxious that he go back to sacraments.
22 Philip Cote - 65 - Blind and losing hearing ... McCann & Thifault - trial about to be.
